bullets: New: Today has a Treatment starts checklist. When a new patient is booked for a start, tick Profile created to open their profile. On the day of the start, tick Case Management updated once you've moved them to 6. Started in NextGen.
New: The Consults tab now has Kept Start, CM Updated and CM Flag columns. A patient whose start was kept is taken off the waitlist and flagged until Case Management shows 6. Started.
New: You can record today's copay at check-in, and change it any time afterward from the visit card, even after check-out. At check-out you can also edit what the patient owes.
New: Click a visit on the Schedule to put the patient on a waitlist for a sooner date. After each appointment list upload, you'll be told when an opening fits.

New: Transfers are on the patient's Protocol page: discontinue them now, or schedule the transfer and confirm it at their last visit here. Upload a NextGen report that includes other clinics to see whether they're booked there.

Fixed: Schedule tiles now show the patient code and MRN instead of just a time. Start visits are flagged when the rest of the index isn't booked. Older NextGen files now upload, and Friday PM availability on the tracker reads correctly.
